children: AstraZeneca said perioperative IMFINZI plus neoadjuvant enfortumab vedotin met VOLGA Phase III endpoints in MIBC, cutting EFS risk by 49% (HR 0.51; p<0.0001) and death risk by 42% (HR 0.58; p=0.0027), with median EFS and OS not yet reached.

This is a late-stage confirmation building on AZN’s push to make IMFINZI a perioperative backbone in bladder cancer beyond cisplatin-eligible patients. A major catalyst would be U.S. approval, rapid guideline inclusion, and clear label wording enabling broad use in cisplatin-ineligible MIBC.
